dreamers-note.description: Global entry point for adding command text, bullets, facts, decisions, or follow-ups into the correct existing or new note in the cyborg Obsidian vault through the dreamers-note project framework. Use when the user asks to add, file, place, remember, or record new note content and wants a proposed destination/context before vault edits.
dreamers-note.payloadMapping: Treat the user's message as the note-add command text unless they provide a separate payload.

dreamers-note-capture.description: Global entry point for adding or formatting quick notes, inbox captures, and daily-note entries in the cyborg Obsidian vault through the dreamers-note project framework. Use when the user asks to add a note, capture a thought, append to a daily note, or record raw material for later AI organization.
dreamers-note-capture.payloadMapping: Treat the user's message as capture text, preserving explicit daily-note append requests.

dreamers-note-import.description: Global entry point for importing an existing Markdown or text file into the correct location in the cyborg Obsidian vault through the dreamers-note project framework. Use when the user asks to add, import, file, or place an existing note file such as ~/Desktop/linux.md into the vault.
dreamers-note-import.payloadMapping: Treat the user's message, including any source paths such as ~/Desktop/linux.md, as the import request.

dreamers-note-review.description: Global entry point for reviewing one cyborg Obsidian vault note for proper tags, backlinks, location, ownership, duplicate risk, body style, and retrieval quality through the dreamers-note project framework.
dreamers-note-review.payloadMapping: Treat the user's message as a request to resolve and review exactly one vault note unless they provide a separate note path or title.

dreamers-note-refactor.description: Global entry point for branch-scoped cyborg Obsidian vault refactors that batch single-note reviews, apply reviewable edits on a feature branch, and open a PR with reviewer-attention notes.
dreamers-note-refactor.payloadMapping: Treat the user's message as the vault refactor scope, including any folder paths, note paths, queue names, or branch and PR hints.
